template.name: pignus/vault

params.label: Oracle key, whose format-2 attestations price the collateral in the debt asset
params.name: ORACLE

params.label: Precision of the oracle's price: price / 10^PRECISION debt atoms per collateral atom
params.name: PRECISION

params.label: Liquidation threshold: the vault is unhealthy below this collateral ratio, in basis points
params.name: LIQ_BP

params.label: Liquidation target: a liquidation restores the vault at most to this collateral ratio, in basis points
params.name: TARGET_BP

params.label: Liquidation bonus: a liquidator seizes collateral worth at most this share of what it repays, in basis points
params.name: BONUS_BP

params.label: Maturity: from this Unix time anyone may call the loan at an attested price
params.name: MATURITY

params.label: Recovery: from this Unix time anyone may pay the whole collateral to the lender
params.name: RECOVER_AFTER

paths.effect: Pays the lender at output 2k+1 at least one atom of DEBT_ASSET. Below DEBT_OUT, output 2k is this vault again, holding the same collateral, owing DEBT_OUT less the payment; at or above it, output 2k pays the borrower at least the whole collateral and the vault closes. This coin is input k.
paths.name: repay

paths.effect: Output 2k is this vault again, with its state unchanged, holding more collateral than this coin. This coin is input k.
paths.name: top_up

paths.effect: With ORACLE's format-2 attestation of the price of COLL in DEBT_ASSET at PRECISION, newer than LAST_TIME, its time the transaction's lock time, its beacon live at an input of BEACON_ASSET: pays the lender at output 2k+1 and repays r, that payment up to DEBT_OUT. Before MATURITY the vault must be under LIQ_BP at that price and r no more than takes it to TARGET_BP; from MATURITY any r. The liquidator keeps collateral worth at most r * BONUS_BP / 10000 at that price. Below DEBT_OUT, output 2k is this vault again with the rest of the collateral, owing DEBT_OUT less r, LAST_TIME the attestation's time, and at or above LIQ_BP at that price; at DEBT_OUT the vault closes, and output 2k, which must exist and be explicit, counts as returned what it pays the borrower in COLL. This coin is input k.
paths.name: liquidate

paths.effect: Once the lock time reaches RECOVER_AFTER, pays the lender at output 2k at least the whole collateral. This coin is input k.
paths.name: recover

slots.label: Debt outstanding, in the debt asset
slots.name: DEBT_OUT

slots.label: Time of the newest attestation a liquidation used, or of the loan's start
slots.name: LAST_TIME

template.summary: A loan's collateral in one coin, with its terms and its debt beside the program: repaid in part or whole by anyone, topped up by anyone, liquidated in part under a fresh oracle price only while unhealthy, and recoverable by the lender only long after maturity.

witness.name: PATH
witness.type: Either<Either<(), ()>, Either<(u64, u32, u256, Signature, u32, bool), ()>>

call_at_maturity.transaction: as a liquidation, closing: the surplus to the borrower

liquidate_partial.transaction: the vault, a beacon coin and the liquidator's coin; the successor, the lender, the beacon, the seizure, change

recover.transaction: the vault and a fee coin; the collateral to the lender

repay_full.transaction: the vault and a debt-asset coin; the collateral to the borrower, the lender's payment

repay_partial.transaction: the vault and a debt-asset coin; the successor and the lender's payment

top_up.transaction: the vault and a collateral coin; the vault again, holding more
